name: ProBook X15 Ultra
description: The TechMaster ProBook X15 Ultra is a premium laptop designed for professionals who demand performance and portability. Featuring the latest 12th generation processor, stunning 4K OLED display, and all-day battery life, this laptop delivers exceptional performance for even the most demanding tasks. The sleek aluminum chassis is both durable and lightweight, making it perfect for professionals on the go.
highlights: Up to 12 hours of battery life

specifications.Processor: Intel Core i9-12900H (14 cores, up to 5.0 GHz)
specifications.Ports: 2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB-A 3.2, HDMI 2.1, SD card reader

features.title: Professional Performance
features.description: Tackle demanding workloads with ease thanks to the powerful 12th Gen Intel Core i9 processor and NVIDIA RTX graphics.

features.title: Stunning Display
features.description: Experience true-to-life colors and perfect blacks with the 4K OLED display that covers 100% of the DCI-P3 color gamut.

features.title: All-Day Battery
features.description: Stay productive all day with up to 12 hours of battery life and fast charging technology that provides 50% charge in just 30 minutes.

features.title: Enhanced Security
features.description: Protect your data with hardware-level security features including fingerprint reader, IR camera for facial recognition, and TPM 2.0.
